com.eloview.homesdk.peripheralManager

Class Peripheral

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.eloview.homesdk.consts.Consts
      • com.eloview.homesdk.accountManager.AccountManager
        • com.eloview.homesdk.peripheralManager.Peripheral
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.lang.Cloneable

    public class Peripheral
extends AccountManager
    PeripheralManager class provides below operations.
    • Get an auth token using getEloAccessToken.
    • Enable/Disable device ports using JSON string. Currently only USB ports can be turned ON/OFF using setUSBPorts(Context, String, String, Handler)
    • Get device port status in JSON String format. Currently only USB ports status can be read. using getUSBPorts(Context, String, Handler)
    • Get maximum number of USB ports on the device based on the device model using getMaxUSBPort()
    • Start USB monitoring which will reset USB Debug mode to host mode from device mode and enable the USB ports.startUsbMonitoring(Context, String, Handler)
    • Stop USB monitoring. stopUsbMonitoring(Context, String, Handler)

      • setUSBPorts

        public void setUSBPorts(android.content.Context context,
                        java.lang.String accessToken,
                        java.lang.String json,
                        android.os.Handler handler)
        This method is used to enable/disable the USB ports on the device.
        Parameters:
        context - A context object of the calling Class (Activity/Service).
        accessToken - An authentication token received from the Elo servers.
        json - A json string containing configuration of USB ports to be set
        handler - A handler to receive one of the following callback messages:

        AccountManager.TOKEN_VERIFY_FAIL
        Consts.GENERIC_ERROR
        SET_USB_PORTS_RESULT_CODE

      • startUsbMonitoring

        public void startUsbMonitoring(android.content.Context context,
                               java.lang.String accessToken,
                               android.os.Handler handler)
        This method is used to start USB Monitoring. It will reset USB Debug mode to host mode from device mode. It will enable the USB ports.
        Parameters:
        context - A context object of the calling Class (Activity/Service).
        accessToken - An authentication offline token
        handler - A handler to receive one of the following callback messages:

        START_USB_MONITOR_RESULT_CODE
        AccountManager.TOKEN_VERIFY_FAIL
        Consts.GENERIC_ERROR

      • unregisterPeripheralAPIListener

        public void unregisterPeripheralAPIListener(android.content.Context context)
        This method is used to unregister the broadcast receiver registered while using any of the Peripheral APIs.
        Please make sure to call this in the "onPause" and "onDestroy" methods in your activity Lifecycle if you made use of any of the Peripheral APIs. This ensures the receiver is not leaked.
        Parameters:
        context - Context in which the system APIs were used
